title.narrative: Building synergies for Climate Action-Policy Pathways

description.narrative: At a time when South Asian countries are revising their NDCs, it is an opportune moment to engage with the government, public private sectors and the civil society through all the phases of climate action-planning, implementation and evaluation vis a vis loss and damage and advocate for equitable financial mechanisms to mitigate climate debt. This project is aimed at building synergies between varied stakeholders, for climate action at the National and South Asia level to, influence the policy advocacy work on climate change and build the capacity of CA partners and other CSOs across South Asian countries including Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal etc on loss and damage, mitigation, adaptation, climate finance, collecting citizen-generated data, promoting South-South cooperation to improve statistical capacities in the region and review & strengthen the implementation of Financing for Development FfD4 & better representation in international governance structure. The recommendations and Policy Brief will feed into the Christian Aid COP 30 Briefings.
